title: specanchor char-test v1
description: A characterization test freezes what the legacy system currently does, without judging whether it is right. The test executed; its result is recorded either way.

failures.description: Description of failures, linked to the rule's open_questions where relevant. A failure that locates an ambiguity precisely is a finding, not a defect.

tolerance.description: Reference to the comparison policy used.

spec_clauses.description: Optional. The spec clauses this test proves, as SPEC-nnnn.Cn. Each must resolve to a clause a spec declares in its body; every declared clause must be cited by at least one test.
